examples.english: The medication can cause adverse effects such as dizziness and nausea.
examples.persian: این دارو می‌تواند عوارض نامطلوبی مانند سرگیجه و تهوع ایجاد کند.

miniContext: The medication can cause adverse effects such as dizziness and nausea.

examples.english: The dog became aggressive whenever a stranger approached the gate.
examples.persian: سگ هر وقت غریبه‌ای به دروازه نزدیک می‌شد تهاجمی می‌شد.

miniContext: The dog became aggressive whenever a stranger approached the gate.

examples.english: The number of forest fires this summer has reached an alarming rate.
examples.persian: تعداد آتش‌سوزی‌های جنگلی این تابستان به میزان نگران‌کننده‌ای رسیده است.

miniContext: The number of forest fires this summer has reached an alarming rate.

examples.english: Nobody wanted to work with him because he seemed so arrogant about his success.
examples.persian: هیچ‌کس نمی‌خواست با او کار کند چون درباره موفقیتش بسیار متکبر به نظر می‌رسید.

miniContext: Nobody wanted to work with him because he seemed so arrogant about his success.

examples.english: There was an awkward silence after he forgot her name during the toast.
examples.persian: بعد از اینکه او اسم زن را در حین نوشیدن به سلامتی فراموش کرد، سکوتی معذب‌کننده پیش آمد.

miniContext: There was an awkward silence after he forgot her name during the toast.

examples.english: The survey results were biased because only loyal customers were asked.
examples.persian: نتایج نظرسنجی جانبدارانه بود چون فقط از مشتریان وفادار پرسیده شده بود.

miniContext: The survey results were biased because only loyal customers were asked.

examples.english: Her blunt feedback hurt his feelings, but it was honest.
examples.persian: بازخورد صریح و بی‌پرده او احساسات وی را آزرد، اما صادقانه بود.

miniContext: Her blunt feedback hurt his feelings, but it was honest.

examples.english: The office dress code is casual on Fridays.
examples.persian: آیین لباس اداره روزهای جمعه غیررسمی است.

miniContext: The office dress code is casual on Fridays.

examples.english: The hotel staff tried to accommodate our request for a late checkout.
examples.persian: کارکنان هتل سعی کردند درخواست ما برای تخلیه دیرهنگام را در نظر بگیرند.

miniContext: The hotel staff tried to accommodate our request for a late checkout.

examples.english: The job market for software engineers has become extremely competitive.
examples.persian: بازار کار برای مهندسان نرم‌افزار بسیار رقابتی شده است.

miniContext: The job market for software engineers has become extremely competitive.

examples.english: His conservative investment strategy avoided risky stocks.
examples.persian: استراتژی سرمایه‌گذاری محتاط و محافظه‌کارانه او از سهام پرریسک دوری می‌کرد.

miniContext: His conservative investment strategy avoided risky stocks.

examples.english: Reading the contract carefully is critical before you sign anything.
examples.persian: خواندن دقیق قرارداد پیش از امضای هر چیزی بسیار مهم است.

miniContext: Reading the contract carefully is critical before you sign anything.

examples.english: He got defensive the moment anyone questioned his decision.
examples.persian: او به محض اینکه کسی تصمیمش را زیر سوال می‌برد، تدافعی می‌شد.

miniContext: He got defensive the moment anyone questioned his decision.

examples.english: The constant phone notifications were disruptive during the lecture.
examples.persian: اعلان‌های مداوم تلفن در طول سخنرانی مختل‌کننده بودند.

miniContext: The constant phone notifications were disruptive during the lecture.

examples.english: The lion is the dominant predator in that region of the savanna.
examples.persian: شیر شکارچی غالب در آن منطقه از ساوانا است.

miniContext: The lion is the dominant predator in that region of the savanna.

examples.english: There was a dramatic drop in temperature after the storm passed.
examples.persian: پس از عبور طوفان، کاهش شدید و چشمگیری در دما رخ داد.

miniContext: There was a dramatic drop in temperature after the storm passed.

examples.english: Saying goodbye at the airport was an emotional moment for the whole family.
examples.persian: خداحافظی در فرودگاه لحظه‌ای احساسی برای تمام خانواده بود.

miniContext: Saying goodbye at the airport was an emotional moment for the whole family.

examples.english: The doctor warned him about the excessive amount of salt in his diet.
examples.persian: پزشک او را درباره مقدار بیش از حد نمک در رژیم غذایی‌اش هشدار داد.

miniContext: The doctor warned him about the excessive amount of salt in his diet.

examples.english: The crowd grew hostile after the referee made another questionable call.
examples.persian: جمعیت پس از یک تصمیم مشکوک دیگر داور، خصمانه شد.

miniContext: The crowd grew hostile after the referee made another questionable call.

examples.english: She became impatient waiting in the long line at the bank.
examples.persian: او در آن صف طولانی در بانک بی‌صبر شد.

miniContext: She became impatient waiting in the long line at the bank.

examples.english: Buying a car without test-driving it was a rather impulsive decision.
examples.persian: خریدن یک ماشین بدون تست رانندگی کردن آن تصمیمی نسبتاً تکانشی بود.

miniContext: Buying a car without test-driving it was a rather impulsive decision.

examples.english: He felt insecure about his accent when speaking in front of native speakers.
examples.persian: او هنگام صحبت کردن جلوی افراد بومی، نسبت به لهجه‌اش احساس ناامنی و کمبود اعتمادبه‌نفس می‌کرد.

miniContext: He felt insecure about his accent when speaking in front of native speakers.

examples.english: The heat in the kitchen during dinner service was absolutely intense.
examples.persian: گرمای آشپزخانه در طول سرویس شام کاملاً شدید بود.

miniContext: The heat in the kitchen during dinner service was absolutely intense.

examples.english: Despite his fame, the actor remained modest about his achievements.
examples.persian: آن بازیگر با وجود شهرتش درباره دستاوردهایش متواضع باقی ماند.

miniContext: Despite his fame, the actor remained modest about his achievements.

examples.english: Too much negative news can affect a person's mental health.
examples.persian: خبرهای منفی بیش از حد می‌تواند بر سلامت روان فرد تاثیر بگذارد.

miniContext: Too much negative news can affect a person's mental health.

examples.english: Despite the setback, the team remained optimistic about reaching the finals.
examples.persian: با وجود این شکست، تیم درباره رسیدن به فینال خوش‌بین باقی ماند.

miniContext: Despite the setback, the team remained optimistic about reaching the finals.

examples.english: He took a passive role in the project and let his teammates lead.
examples.persian: او نقشی منفعل در پروژه ایفا کرد و اجازه داد هم‌تیمی‌هایش رهبری کنند.

miniContext: He took a passive role in the project and let his teammates lead.

examples.english: The landlord agreed to a reasonable rent increase of five percent.
examples.persian: صاحب‌خانه با افزایش اجاره‌ای منطقی و معقول به میزان پنج درصد موافقت کرد.

miniContext: The landlord agreed to a reasonable rent increase of five percent.

examples.english: My younger sister is quite reserved around people she has just met.
examples.persian: خواهر کوچک‌تر من در کنار افرادی که تازه ملاقات کرده، نسبتاً کم‌حرف و محتاط است.

miniContext: My younger sister is quite reserved around people she has just met.

examples.english: Scientists remained skeptical of the company's claims until the data was published.
examples.persian: دانشمندان تا زمان انتشار داده‌ها نسبت به ادعاهای شرکت شکاک باقی ماندند.

miniContext: Scientists remained skeptical of the company's claims until the data was published.
